name: looped_then_tab_closed
description: A 5 s flick left looping for twenty seconds, then the tab is closed before any play_end can leave the browser. Every heartbeat carries loop_count and content_duration_ms (M-29), so when the server's finaliser closes the session by inactivity it credits the four passes the heartbeats account for — duration x (loop_count + 1) = 20000 — and not a single pass.
viewer: 0-20 s: the reel loops three times without the viewer touching it
20 s: the tab is closed; the queued play_end never flushes
11 min after the last heartbeat: the server's finaliser runs
notes: Before M-29 a heartbeat carried no loop_count, so the session row's loop_count stayed 0 until the play_end arrived; when it never arrived, the clamp (M-26) bound watched_ms to duration x 1 = 5000 and three genuine passes were lost. The web tracker now sends its capped loop count and the duration on every beat; the server takes both under GREATEST like every other running figure. Android sends both on every heartbeat as of 12 Sep 2026, so the same holds there.
